rationale: No existing spec covers applying a saved view against the Build Query tab. logsQueryBuilder-* covers builder mode without saved views; logsVisualizePersistence covers tab persistence without saved views; monaco-query-prefill and logsqueries cover saved views only from the Logs tab (Monaco prefill), never the BuildQueryPage savedBuildConfig restore path. The PR headline (watch on searchObj.meta.savedBuildConfig re-initializing an already-open build tab) has zero coverage, so a brand-new Logs-area spec is required. Registered under the existing Logs-Features group in ci_matrix.json.
